question: Which of the following genera is most commonly associated with urinary infections in humans ?:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Escherichia -> common cause of urinary infections in humans -> 80% CHAIN: Proteus -> associated with urinary infections in humans, especially in complicated cases -> 70% CHAIN: Staphylococcus -> can cause urinary tract infections in humans, but less common compared to Escherichia and Proteus -> 60% CHAIN: Serratia -> rare cause of urinary infections in humans -> 80%
enhanced_information: Escherichia coli is the most commonly associated genus with urinary infections in humans. Proteus is also associated, especially in complicated cases. Staphylococcus can cause urinary tract infections but is less common compared to Escherichia and Proteus. Serratia is a rare cause of urinary infections in humans. Evidence paths support Escherichia and its association with urinary tract infections.
